rv.q: Light on the palate as it is, in the manner of a standard romantic comedy, its bleaker reflections on the vicissitudes of experience are what remain with you.
That touch is the domain here mainly of the wonderful John Mahoney, whose tender performance is the Roundabout production’s chief reward.
Although Mr. Tudyk has all American good looks, neither he nor Ms Parisse have the requisite charisma or onstage chemistry to make magic.

cn.t: Lucas's romantic fantasy receives a moody, touching revival that critics find pleasant if delicate, with the AIDS-era fairy tale resonating emotionally despite struggling somewhat in the cavernous Broadway space.

vs.sum: Completed a major renovation in early 2026 with all seats replaced and legroom expanded, making it one of Broadway's most comfortable and modern houses. New restrooms significantly reduce intermission wait times.

acc.note: Elevators to all levels. 53 assistive listening devices. 11 wheelchair seats across Orchestra and Balcony.
